_comment_1: ZaDeteto GHL Partner Whitelist. Lives at https://zadeteto.com/ghl-locations.json. The Agency JS fetches this on every GHL page load and decides whether to activate the Bulgarian/padlock layer based on the current Location ID.
_comment_2: TO ADD A NEW PARTNER: copy a template entry under 'locations', replace the key with the new Location ID (from the GHL URL /v2/location/XXX/...), set their tier and addons, commit, push. Changes go live within ~60 seconds.
_comment_3: TO UPGRADE A PARTNER'S TIER: change their 'tier' field. Valid values: verified, trusted, premium.
_comment_4: TO ACTIVATE AN ADD-ON: add the addon key to their 'addons' array. Valid addon keys: ai_agents, unlimited_sms.
_comment_5: TO REMOVE A PARTNER: delete their entry. They will see normal GHL again (in English).
